item_text: I feel that I belong in my team or work group.
I feel accepted by the people with whom I work.
I can participate in team activities without feeling excluded.
I feel that my contribution is recognized as part of the team’s collective effort.
My day-to-day interactions with colleagues are generally constructive.
People I work with communicate with me respectfully.
Workplace disagreements are generally handled in a professional manner.
My interactions with colleagues help me carry out my responsibilities effectively.
I can generally rely on the people I work with to fulfil their commitments.
People in my team communicate honestly about matters that affect our work.
I can raise reasonable concerns without undue fear of negative consequences.
I have confidence that workplace concerns will be handled fairly.
